name: Isaac Gym

summaryEn: GPU-accelerated physics environments that generate robot states, actions, and visual trajectories.
scale: Parallel GPU simulation for thousands of environments
scaleZh: 可并行仿真数千个环境
verdict: 大规模 GPU 物理轨迹生成
